All descendants of excluded elements are dropped

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<body><aside class="sidebar"><h2>Related</h2><p>Sidebar text</p></aside><main><p>Main text</p></main></body>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: ['.sidebar']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
